text: Season panel says 'Autumn - day 1/2, year 1' and 'Winter in 2 days' while state.json reports day 4, timeOfDay 0.303 at tick 120076. Session-day numbering differs between panel (season day) and state (world day); 'in 2 days' is rounded up from ~1.7 days.
Three different day numbers on one screen: chronicle says 'Day 5, morning', Season panel says 'Autumn - day 1/2, year 1', state.json says day 4. Expected one consistent calendar.

Right after pressing F to found my settlement (tick ~125508), a huge world-space label '0 here, 0/8 residents' overflows the top of the screen and is clipped behind the HUD; the settlement name above it is cut off entirely. state.json names it just 'Settlement'.

Trees within interact range of my settlement centre cannot be chopped: walkto tree (5.5m from the well) then E toggled Entered/Exited settlement 4 times (ticks 125788-126156) instead of chopping. Expected E to target the tree I'm facing/standing at, or a hint that the settlement takes priority.

Objective 7 'Reach the Village era' progress bar text is clipped on the left: reads 'nbers 4/10 · Buildings 0/2' (Members). Inventory Info panel also jumped to the middle of the screen, overlapping the world view. Tick ~128860.

Build House button: two pt clicks ~9 s apart in real time each just re-armed 'Click again to confirm: Build House.' (ticks 129120, 129340, 129528) and never built. ConfirmGate window is 8 s of wall time; at 2-5 fps a hover+click takes several seconds, so confirming via the mouse is unreliable. Pressing K twice built the Farm fine.

After building Farm+House the status said 'House built. The settlement is now a Village!' but the era badge still reads 'Era: Camp (1/4)' and objective 'Reach the Village era' is incomplete (Members 5/10). Two different meanings of 'Village' (settlement tier vs nation era) contradict each other on screen. Also 'Chronicle: your news' is filled with other nations' border rivalries, pushing my own events off.

At night of season day 1 (chronicle 'Day 5, night', tick ~135000) the Season panel still reads 'Autumn - day 1/2' and 'Winter in 2 days'. Winter is about one day away (state: day 4, timeOfDay ~0.8; winter at day 6 / tick 180000). The countdown overstates how long the player has to prepare. Also apple price at my market fell from 54/48 to 9/9 within ~6000 ticks.

Inside my settlement I clicked 'Talk to Phoebe Jones (Stranger)' at (160,383) (tick 135224); the reply came from Alice White instead. The contextual pawn rows re-target to whichever pawn is nearest as they walk, so at a few fps the button changes target between hover and click.
